node-1.label: 50-year-old female presented with abdominal pain, nausea, and progressive fatigue starting a few weeks before hospitalization

node-2.label: Symptoms began a few weeks before hospitalization, following treatment with oral antibiotics for a dental infection

node-3.label: Medical history included smoldering myeloma (diagnosed weeks before admission), autoimmune thyroiditis (since 2018), and Sjogren's syndrome (since 2020)

node-4.label: Physical examination showed normal vitals, enlarged liver, and bilateral leg edema
